bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears made several roster moves this week, including placing tight end Cole Kmet on Reserve/Injured while also activating players like Kyler Gordon and Shemar Turner off the PUP list. This comes as the team continues integrating newly acquired All-Pro defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons, whom the Titans received 2027 and 2028 first-round picks, plus a 2027 fourth-round pick for, in exchange for Simmons and a 2028 fifth-round pick , with GM Ryan Poles noting the Bears aren't adopting a "F them picks" mindset with the Jeffery Simmons trade .

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions hosted the undefeated Minnesota Vikings at Ford Field on Sunday, November 1, with starting cornerback Roger McCreary active for the contest despite dealing with a recent foot injury entering the weekend. Detroit's defense has shown recent improvement, as the Lions have allowed 38 combined points in their last two games after allowing an average of 32 points through their first four.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The biggest Packers story from the last 24 hours centers on running back Josh Jacobs, as the NFL said it will look into additional allegations of physical and verbal abuse by Jacobs that were revealed as part of a public records release from the Hobart/Lawrence Police Department , with the allegations showing three women alleged abuse by Jacobs in incidents dating back to April 2021 . Meanwhile, on the field, NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reported that the Packers and Micah Parsons are targeting their Week 12 matchup against the Los Angeles Rams on Thanksgiving Eve for the star pass rusher's return from his torn ACL.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings enter Week 8 as the NFL's only unbeaten team at 6-0 , preparing for a high-stakes road matchup against the Detroit Lions and their explosive offense. Ahead of the game, Aaron Jones was cleared for Sunday's game against the Lions after avoiding an injury designation for his knee, giving Minnesota a healthier backfield as they try to extend their historic start.
